get_donor_info(hto_df, pool_info_df, sep, col_list)¶

Return donor information for each cell barcode for multi-HTO setup.

This function returns a pandas series containing demultiplexed donor info according to the data contained in the wet lab info file. This function is made specially for multi-HTO setup.

Parameters:

  • hto_df (pandas.DataFrame)

  • matrix (A series of cell barcodes from gene count)

  • pool_info_df (pandas.DataFrame)

  • and (Subset of wet lab file containing multi-HTO information) – SubID (donor IDs)

  • col_list (list) – List of column names in the wet lab file in the sequence: - pool name - HTO names (separated by ‘sep’) - HTO barcode - donor info

  • sep (str)

Returns:

pd.Series – Contains donor IDs with cell barcodes as index

_ret_htos_calico_solo(bcs, df_s, samp, sep, col_list, dem_cs, donor_convert, hto_count, multi_hto_setp)¶

Return HTO information and classification for each cell barcode.

This function returns a 2 pandas series representing donor IDs and HTO name (used for calico_solo) and the number of doublets and negatives identified.

Parameters:

  • bcs (pandas.Series) – A pd series of cell barcodes from gene count matrix

  • df_s (pandas.DataFrame) – Wet lab file containing HTO information and SubID (donor IDs) for each pool

  • samp (str) – Pool name (present in df_s file)

  • sep (Optional[str]) – Separator used if all HTOs and donors are present in one row or if multi-HTO setup otherwise None

  • col_list (list[str, str]) – List of column names (first val HTO, second val SubID)

  • dem_cs (pandas.Series) – A pd series with cell barcodes as index and “HTO classification” (solo output)

  • donor_convert (bool) – If donor names have to be converted from the names used in calico_solo (hashsolo) demultiplexing method

  • hto_count (int) – If run for multi-HTO setup this indicates the position of HTO in the sequence

  • multi_hto_setp (bool) – True for multi-HTO setup

Returns:

HashSoloResult – An instance of the dataclass containing:

  • donor_ids : Sample name indexed by cell barcodes

  • hto_names : HTO name indexed by cell barcodes

  • n_doublets : Total count of doublets

  • n_negatives : Total count of negatives

Return type:

HashSoloResult

demux_by_calico_solo(bcs, df_s, samp, sep, col_list, dem_cs, donor_convert, hto_count, multi_hto_sep='')¶

Assign donor and HTO classifications using HashSolo output.

This function performs donor assignment using HashSolo (formerly calico_solo) classifications generated from HTO demultiplexing.

Parameters:

  • bcs (pandas.Series) – Cell barcodes from the gene count matrix.

  • df_s (pandas.DataFrame) – Wet lab file containing HTO information and donor IDs for each pool.

  • samp (str) – Pool name present in df_s.

  • sep (str) – Separator used when all HTOs and donors are present in a single row. Set to None for multi-HTO setup.

  • col_list (list[str, str]) – Column names where the first value corresponds to the HTO column and the second value corresponds to the donor ID column.

  • dem_cs (pandas.Series) – Series containing HashSolo HTO classifications with cell barcodes as index.

  • donor_convert (bool) – Whether donor names should be converted from the naming convention used by HashSolo.

  • hto_count (int) – Position of the HTO in the sequence for multi-HTO setup.

  • multi_hto_sep (str) – Separator used for multi-HTO setups.

Returns:

tuple – A tuple containing:

donor_ids

Donor IDs indexed by cell barcode.

hto_names

HTO names indexed by cell barcode.

demux_stats

Demultiplexing statistics.

Return type:

tuple[pandas.Series, pandas.Series, list[str]]

See also

_ret_htos_calico_solo

To generate donor IDs and HTO labels.

set_don_ids(x)¶

Change naming conventions of Vireo

Use this function to change the naming convetion used in the vireo output - donor_ids.tsv - (generally to make this similar to that of calico_solo/hashsolo but also suits to beautify donor names so as to make it feasible to be classified by using a converter file.

Parameters:

x (str) – A string representing a donor classification from vireo

Returns:

str – The ‘changed’ classification

Return type:

str

demux_by_vireo(bcs, vir_out_file, conv_df=None, donor_col=None, conv_col=None, pool_col=None, pool_name=None)¶

Main function for classification by vireoSNP.

This function assigns vireo classification.

Paramters¶

bcs

A pd series of cell barcodes from gene count matrix.

vir_out_file

Path to donor_ids.tsv file produced by vireo.

conv_df

A converter file to change donor names in the vireo output, if needed.

donor_col

Donor names containing column in the converter file that matches the vireo output.

conv_col

Column, in the converter file, containing the converted names.

pool_col

Column, in the converter file, containing the pool names.

pool_name

Pool name.

returns:

  • pd.Series – Classification by vireo per cell

  • list – Demux stats

  • pd.Series – Converted donor names of classification by vireo per cell

Parameters:

  • bcs (pandas.Series)

  • vir_out_file (str)

  • conv_df (Optional[pandas.DataFrame])

  • donor_col (Optional[str])

  • conv_col (Optional[str])

  • pool_col (Optional[str])

  • pool_name (Optional[str])

Return type:

tuple[pandas.Series, list[str], Optional[pandas.Series]]

process_columns(config, pool_name, df)¶

Process annotations by reading a JSON recipe.

This function provides an output, which can be used to annotate sample-level (pool-level) metrics using a template (JSON) and parsing a file containing relevant information.

_load_file(sub_prog, all_files_dict, cache)¶

Return (and cache) the DataFrame for a given sub_prog. Raises RuntimeError if the underlying file cannot be read.

_lookup_value(temp_df, sub_prog, val, mapper)¶

Look up a single value from a loaded DataFrame using the mapper. Returns the value, or “” if the mapper entry or column is absent. Trailing commas are stripped (demux legacy format).

write_logs(big_df, mapper, all_files_dict, no_progs, *args)¶

Build one output row for a single sample.

  • no_progs (list of sub_prog prefixes to skip)

list of values in column order
